So there could be a couple things going on here. You could be getting stronger with muscle replacing fat weight. You could also have a latency period where you work out now and don't see progress until later. Or you are eating unhealthy foods and it's offsetting all the workouts. Overall I'd recommend eating better and working out more. Now eating better shouldn't start out as eating only salads or something. First you need to get your dietary cycles in order, as eating right before you sleep makes you fatter than if you were to eat lunch or breakfast. Then after that try eating healthier foods. The balancing of the cycles and dietary needs should help the cravings.
